## VMC Ubbink Ubiflux Vigor — v1.3.0

Minor release adding a **Model** option so the airflow range follows your unit, which brings support for the **W600** and the **W225**.

### New
- **Model** option (`W225` / `W325` / `W400` / `W600`) in the integration setup and under **Configure**, for both connection modes. The **Airflow Rate** slider takes its range from the model: W225 40–225, W325 50–325, W400 50–400, W600 100–600 m³/h. The device card shows the chosen model.
- The bundled `ubbink-server` accepts 40–600 m³/h (previously 50–400). W225 and W600 owners in Server mode should rebuild it from this release.

### Fixes
- An airflow rate rejected by the unit or by the server no longer stays on the slider: the value reverts and a warning is logged.

### Background
All Ubiflux Vigor models share the UWA2-B control board and the same Modbus register map (Ubbink's Modbus instruction is Brink's UWA2-B/UWA2-E document, which also covers the Flair 600). Only the adjustable airflow range differs, and the unit does not publish a register to detect its model, so the model is a setting. Thanks to @PolDeLepel for the W600 request.

Issue: [#31](https://github.com/dimgen/homeassistant-vmc-ubbink/issues/31). Change: [#32](https://github.com/dimgen/homeassistant-vmc-ubbink/pull/32).

### Upgrade
Update to v1.3.0 through HACS and restart Home Assistant. Existing installs keep behaving as a W400 (50–400 m³/h) until you pick your model under **Settings → Devices & services → VMC Ubbink → Configure**. Server-mode users of a W225 or W600 should also rebuild `ubbink-server`.
